title: Upper shriek as the right adjoint to proper direct image
statement: Let $h:X\to Y$ be a proper morphism [def-weil-proper-morphism] between Noetherian schemes. On the derived categories [def-pc-derived-category] of quasi-coherent sheaves, write $h^!$ for a chosen right adjoint to the derived direct image $Rh_*:D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_X)\to D_{\mathrm{QCoh}}(\mathcal O_Y)$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]; such a right adjoint exists by [lem-pc-noetherian-derived-direct-image-right-adjoint].
